text: Dynamic globals and startup hooks shall form one graph with unique nonempty exact decoded UTF-8 IDs and explicit `after` edges. Duplicate/missing/self/cyclic dependencies shall be diagnosed before action execution. Constant globals shall have no nodes. Imports, source order, and address references shall not infer edges.
